items.title: 7.2 Waves ki superposition ka usool (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 7.2 with Fig. 7.4 and the noise-cancelling steps (PDF 141-143).

blocks.title: Superposition ka usool
blocks.text: Agar medium ke kisi zarre par ek hi waqt do waves asar karein to zarre ka nateeja displacement un ke alag alag displacements ka algebraic majmooa (sum) hai. Doosre lafzon mein, alag waves ke displacements jama ho kar naya wave pattern banate hain (Fig. 7.4).

items: Agar ek doosre par charhti do waves ka phase ek ho to un ka nateeja displacement y = y1 + y2 hai, jahan y1 aur y2 wave 1 aur wave 2 ke displacements aur y nateeja hai. Khaas kar agar y1 = y2 ho to nateeja displacement y = 2 y1, ya y = 2 y2 hai (Fig. 7.4a).
Agar ek doosre ko kaatti do waves ka phase ulat ho to nateeja displacement y = y1 + (-y2), ya y = y1 - y2 hai. Khaas kar agar y1 = y2 ho to nateeja displacement y = 0 hai (Fig. 7.4b).

blocks.alt: Teen qataarein. Surkh wave 1 aur neeli wave 2, aik jaisi wavelength aur amplitude, crests seedh mein. Neeche jamni resultant ka amplitude dugna hai. Caption kehta hai crest crest se milta hai aur amplitude dugna hota hai.
blocks.caption: Ek phase mein do lehrein jama hoti hain (constructive) (Figure 7.4a ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Yun agar medium ke kisi zarre par ek hi waqt n waves asar karein aur alag alag n waves se us ke displacements y1, y2, ..., yn hon, to in n waves ke mushtarka asar se zarre ka nateeja displacement y tamam displacements ka algebraic majmooa hai: y = y1 + y2 + ... + yn. Yehi waves ki superposition ka usool hai. Riyazi taur par ise y(x,t) = y1(x,t) + y2(x,t) + ... + yn(x,t) bhi likh sakte hain, jahan y(x,t) nateeja wave aur y1(x,t), y2(x,t), ..., yn(x,t) alag waves hain; waves ke silsile mein y(x,t) kisi nuqte x aur waqt t par wave function ya wave displacement hai, jo wave ki shakal aur waqt ke saath us ki tabdeeli bayan karta hai. Superposition ka usool linear waves, ya chhote amplitude ki waves, par lagu hota hai.

blocks.caption: Superposition se paida hone wale mazahir
rows: Ek hi frequency ki do waves ek hi simt mein
Thori mukhtalif frequencies ki do waves ek hi simt mein
Barabar frequency ki do waves ulti simton mein

blocks.text: Waves ki superposition ka usool lagu kar ke noise-cancelling headphones na-pasandeeda shor ko moassar taur par khatam karte hain aur zyada pursukoon sunne ka tajurba dete hain:

items: Headphones mein ek ya zyada microphones hote hain jo ird gird ka shor pakarte hain, jaise pas-e-manzar ki baatein, engine ki gharghharahat ya koi bhi mahauli shor.
Microphone sound signals ko headphones mein amplifier aur processing unit tak bhejta hai.
Processing unit ek anti-noise signal banata hai jo amplitude aur phase ke lihaz se ird gird ke shor ka bilkul ulat hai.
Phir anti-noise signal headphones se matlooba audio, jaise music ya awaz, ke saath chalaya jata hai.
Jab anti-noise signal ird gird ke shor se milta hai to dono waves ek doosre ko khatam kar deti hain, aur sunna kahin zyada khamosh ho jata hai.

blocks.alt: Teen qataarein. Surkh wave 1 aur neeli wave 2, aik jaisi wavelength aur amplitude, aik ka crest doosre ke trough ke saamne. Neeche jamni resultant seedhi lakeer hai. Caption kehta hai crest trough se milta hai aur lehrein khatam ho jati hain.
blocks.caption: Ulte phase mein do lehrein khatam hoti hain (destructive) (Figure 7.4b ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Agarche yeh had se zyada saada bayan hai, kyunke noise-cancelling headphones behtareen cancellation ke liye pecheeda algorithms aur kai microphones istemal karte hain, phir bhi un ka kaam samajhne ke liye superposition ka bunyadi usool lazmi hai. Safed light se bana interference pattern Ponder Upon box mein dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt: Superposition ka usool bayan kijiye aur us se noise-cancelling headphones ki wazahat kijiye (comprehensive question 7.1; MCQ 7.2). Jab do barabar waves bilkul ulat phase mein milein to nateeja kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Jab do ya zyada waves ek hi waqt kisi zarre par asar karein to us ka displacement alag displacements ka algebraic majmooa hai, y = y1 + y2 + ... + yn. Headphones ird gird ka shor record karte hain, usi amplitude magar ulat phase ka anti-noise signal banate hain aur music ke saath chalate hain; jahan dono milte hain y = y1 - y2 = 0, to shor khatam ho jata hai aur music baqi rehta hai. Bilkul ulat phase mein do barabar waves ka nateeja displacement sifar hai.

items: Superposition: nateeja displacement = alag displacements ka algebraic majmooa; ek phase mein y = y1 + y2 (barabar hon to 2 y1); ulat phase mein y = y1 - y2 (barabar hon to sifar); y(x,t) = y1(x,t) + ... + yn(x,t); linear, chhote amplitude ki waves ke liye.
Is se interference, beats aur stationary waves bante hain. Noise-cancelling headphones: microphones, processor, ulat phase ka anti-noise, cancellation.
